question: A dart is thrown at a square board of side 20 cm containing a circular target ring of radius 7 cm. Find geometric probability of hit.
options: Total Area = 400 sq cm. Target Area = (22/7)*7^2 = 154 sq cm. P(Hit) = 154/400 = 77/200 = 0.385.
explanation: Total Area = 400 sq cm. Target Area = (22/7)*7^2 = 154 sq cm. P(Hit) = 154/400 = 77/200 = 0.385.
